expected_result.title: Coordinated Financial Fraud Attack — SMS Blaster Chain
expected_result.explanation: A coordinated financial fraud attack was detected targeting victim@example.kz. The attack followed the Kazakhstan SMS Blaster pattern: the victim received a fake Kaspi Bank bonus SMS with a phishing URL, their credentials were found in two breach databases, an attacker logged in from a known Tor exit node in Russia immediately after the phishing attempt, a deepfake voice call impersonating a Kaspi Bank security officer was detected, C2-like outbound traffic was observed on port 4444, and 47 failed login attempts in 3 minutes confirmed a brute-force attack. All six detection signals converge on the same victim identity, IP address, and time window, confirming a coordinated attack chain.
